title: Should LLMs be WEIRD? Exploring WEIRDness and Human Rights in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with multiple-choice questions from the World Values Survey (WVS) and calculating the similarity of their responses to human survey data across different countries, then correlating this alignment with the countries' WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, Democratic) metric scores.

Using an LLM-as-a-judge approach to evaluate whether the models' generated responses to the WVS questions violate articles from global and regional human rights charters (e.g., UDHR, ASEAN, ACHR, ACHPR).
